name: Padiernos (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of purple, yellow and purple in the proportions 10:1:7, the upper stripe charged with three yellow five-pointed stars set two and one towards the hoist.
history: The blazon of the arms was approved on 13 June 2000 and the description of the flag published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 163 of 23 August 2000: a rectangular flag of 2:3 formed of three horizontal stripes in the proportions 10/18, 1/18 and 7/18, purple with three yellow five-pointed stars set two and one at a third from the hoist, yellow and purple.

features.role: three stars set two and one at a third from the hoist
